name.description: Display name of this lead source

kind.description: Source type: Google Sheets pull, or Ringba/TrueCall inbound call webhook

supplier_name.description: Supplier this source's leads are attributed to

campaign_id.description: Campaign this source's leads are attributed to

api_key_id.description: Reference to the ApiKey record used to authenticate ingestion through processLead

mapping.description: JSON object mapping source column/payload key -> our lead field name

sheet_id.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID (extracted from URL)

sync_interval.description: How often the scheduled sync pulls rows. New sheets are continuous (every scheduler tick). The longer intervals remain for sheets that should not be hammered.

dedupe_column.description: Source column used as the de-dupe key; falls back to a hash of the whole row

seen_keys.description: JSON array of de-dupe markers already ingested, so the same row is not ingested twice

webhook_key.description: Secret key appended to the inbound call webhook URL (Ringba/TrueCall)

last_sync_status.description: Short result of the last sync/event e.g. 'Ingested 4 rows'

ingested_count.description: Total leads ingested through this source

purpose.description: What this sheet is for. Decides where synced rows are written. Absent or 'leads' means ingest through processLead, which is the pre-existing behaviour.

spreadsheet_name.description: Human readable spreadsheet title, cached from Google so the list does not show bare IDs

google_account.description: Email of the Google account this sheet is read with. One connected account today; the field exists so multi-account does not need a migration.

match_field.description: Our field used to find the record this row belongs to, e.g. email, mobile, sid, buyer_id, lead_id, utm_source

match_column.description: Sheet column holding the match value

match_field_2.description: Fallback field to match on when the primary finds nothing, e.g. mobile first then email

match_column_2.description: Sheet column holding the fallback match value

buyer_codes.description: JSON array of buyer_code values this sheet covers. One buyer pins every row to it; several means the buyer is resolved per row from a buyer column, falling back to the lead's own buyer.

date_column.description: Sheet column holding the row's event date, used for bucketing and for cost attribution

date_field.description: Our date field the date column is written to

included_columns.description: JSON array of sheet columns to read. Empty or absent means every column.

link_type.description: Whether this sheet belongs to a buyer, a supplier, or neither

buyer_code.description: Buyer this sheet belongs to, held as buyer_code to match how Lead.buyer_id is stored

purpose_config.description: JSON object of per-purpose options, e.g. which column carries the disposition or the spend amount

last_run_counts.description: JSON object of the last run's outcome counts: read, matched, written, skipped, errored
